name: Chrome Dino
description: The T-Rex runner from Chrome's offline page: jump the cacti, duck the birds, and keep going as the game speeds up and night falls. Drawn on a 2D canvas.
goal: Chrome Dino (T-Rex runner). Press Space or ArrowUp to jump, ArrowDown to duck. Avoid the obstacles. Survive as long as possible; the score grows with the distance run.

score.expression: (() => { const r = Runner.instance_; return { over: r.crashed, score: r.distanceMeter.getActualDistance(r.distanceRan) }; })()
score.label: distance
